card.title: Fold a sheet of paper 42 times

body.question: A sheet of paper is 0.1 mm thick. If you could fold it in half 42 times, about how thick would the stack be, in kilometres?
body.reveal: About 440,000 km, which is farther than the Moon (about 384,400 km away). Each fold doubles the thickness, so 0.1 mm × 2^42 ≈ 440 million metres. In real life you can't fold paper that many times.

probes.question: How thick, in km, would a 0.1 mm sheet be after 42 folds in half?
